clue.text: Report of carnal love in board game

indicators.note: a report is something heard, so the word for carnal is taken by its sound only

parts.note: carnal desire is lewd
love is zero in tennis scoring, the letter O

explanation.surface: A rumour of steamy goings-on inside a children's board game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Report of' asks for the sound of LEWD, spelt LUD, followed by O.
explanation.definitionFit: A simple dice-and-counters race game played on a cross-shaped board.

clue.text: Outrageous, unending board game

parts.note: outrageous behaviour is wild

indicators.note: unending says the last letter of the word for board is dropped

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A scandalous board game that never seems to finish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Board game' reads as one phrase, but board is wordplay and game alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The wild pig is hunted for sport and food, making it a kind of quarry animal.

clue.text: Draws up report on board game

indicators.note: a report is heard, so the name of the board game counts only by how it sounds

parts.note: draughts is the British name for checkers, played on a chequered board

explanation.surface: Someone writes up an account of a board game.
explanation.walkthrough: DRAUGHTS is the British name for checkers; it is said the same as the definition's word.
explanation.definitionFit: To draw up a document is to prepare a first written version of it.

clue.text: Moved in secret and went ahead after complacent start to game

parts.note: complacent means smug

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter, here of game

parts.note: to go ahead of others is to lead, past tense led

explanation.surface: A player sneaks a move and then takes the lead after a self-satisfied opening.
explanation.definitionFit: Smuggling is moving goods covertly past the authorities, the past tense matching moved.

clue.text: Muesli before board game?

parts.note: rabbit is a game animal shot by hunters
board as in board and lodging means meals, food

explanation.surface: Eating breakfast cereal before settling down to a board game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Board game' looks like one thing; it splits into board, meals, and game, a rabbit, and the game piece comes first.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang jibe at healthy cereals and salads as fit only for small herbivores.

clue.text: Fit to fight, taking a run out

indicators.note: taking something out removes it, here the letter for run from the word for fight

parts.note: to fight verbally is to argue
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Ready to fight, a cricketer takes a single and is run out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fit' looks like an adjective meaning healthy, but it is a noun: a bout of fever.
explanation.definitionFit: An ague is a feverish shivering bout, as in a fit of fever.

clue.text: Month One: curb extremes of naughtiest children

parts.note: Jun is the abbreviation for June
the Roman numeral for one is I

indicators.note: curbing the extremes trims the first and last letters off the word for naughtiest

parts.note: the naughtiest, the most badly behaved, are the worst

explanation.surface: In June, a teacher resolves to rein in the very worst of the children.
explanation.walkthrough: Naughtiest gives WORST (bad meaning naughty), and 'curb extremes of' drops W and T, leaving ORS.
explanation.definitionFit: Juniors are young pupils, children of primary-school age.

clue.text: A penny once lost from board game played in bar

indicators.note: played signals that the letters of board game are rearranged after the removal

parts.note: d was the symbol for a penny in old pre-decimal British money

explanation.surface: A pub board game played in the bar, once with a penny stake, goes missing.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of BOARD GAME, less A and D ('lost from'), are rearranged to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An embargo is an official ban, so it bars trade.

clue.text: See 5
Flimsy deceit by the French called in

indicators.note: in places the word for called inside the word for deceit

parts.note: a fib is a small lie
called on the phone, rang
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A thin lie told by the French when they were called in.
explanation.definitionFit: Frangible means easily broken, so fragile or flimsy.

clue.text: Man or woman? Not black or white, but grey and no mistake

definitions.text: Man or woman? Not black or white

indicators.note: a mistake scrambles things, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Asking whether a person is male or female: the answer is neither, but somewhere in between.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not black or white' extends the definition: neither one sex nor the other. 'Mistake' rearranges GREY AND NO.
explanation.definitionFit: An androgynous person is neither clearly male nor clearly female, a grey area.

clue.text: Reveals secrets of chess — how shocking

indicators.note: the secrets of a phrase are letters tucked inside its words

explanation.surface: A scandalous exposé of the chess world.
explanation.definitionFit: To show something is to reveal it; both are third-person verbs here.

clue.text: Board game played with these

indicators.note: something played with is toyed with and rearranged, so these letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: Instructions saying which pieces a board game uses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Board game' wants to be one phrase; board is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A sheet of plywood or hardboard is a flat board.

clue.text: Tardy: needs oil to get moving?

definitions.text: Tardy: needs oil to get moving?

indicators.note: getting the letters moving shifts them round into a new order

explanation.surface: A slow machine just needs lubricating to start working.
explanation.walkthrough: Tardy is both the definition's key word and part of the fodder with OIL; the whole clue reads as a definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Dilatory means slow or tending to delay, the same as tardy.

clue.text: Missing the start of board game, where pressure is high

indicators.note: missing the start means the opening letter is dropped

parts.note: bridge is a card game, played on a board in duplicate tournaments

explanation.surface: Skipping the opening of a game in a high-pressure situation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Where pressure is high' sounds like a tense moment, but it is weather.
explanation.definitionFit: In meteorology an elongated area of high atmospheric pressure is called this.

clue.text: Rush back for game

indicators.note: back says the word for rush is read backwards

parts.note: a rush is a reed-like water plant

explanation.surface: Hurrying home to a game.
explanation.definitionFit: Deer are hunted as quarry, so they are game.

clue.text: Critical attack from board game players

indicators.note: game as in willing to play about, so the letters of board are rearranged

parts.note: a side is a team of players

explanation.surface: A scathing review arising from a board game group.
explanation.definitionFit: A broadside is a fierce verbal or written attack, from a ship firing all its guns on one side.

clue.text: One speculating cartel at violent games venue

parts.note: a bull is a speculator betting on rising prices
a ring is a group of traders fixing prices

explanation.surface: A stock-market gambler joins a cartel at a stadium.
explanation.definitionFit: The arena where bullfights are staged is a venue for brutal spectacle.

clue.text: See 16
Boatman cleans his bottom here, with underwear cut short

parts.note: a slip is a woman's undergarment
to dock a tail is to cut it short

explanation.surface: The setter tells us where he washes his behind, with his pants trimmed.
explanation.walkthrough: Boatman is the setter; the bottom is a boat's hull.
explanation.definitionFit: A slipway dock where a vessel is hauled out so its hull can be cleaned.

clue.text: 100 Club — together in music, off the scale

parts.note: a ton is a hundred, so a hundred is a ton
to club together is to join forces, ally

explanation.surface: At the famous 100 Club, musicians play in unison.
explanation.walkthrough: The 100 Club is a London music venue, which the surface invokes.
explanation.definitionFit: Music written without a key or tonal centre is not on any scale.

clue.text: Inappropriate victory over a favourite indigenous people

parts.note: NA stands for not applicable, inappropriate
jo is Scots for a sweetheart, a favourite

explanation.surface: An unjust win against a favourite.
explanation.definitionFit: A Native American nation of the south-western United States.

clue.text: Attack in game

definitions.meaning: a wading bird shot as game

explanation.definitionFit: Snipe the bird is shot as game; to snipe is to fire at or carp at.

clue.text: Walk in pomp and state around the wood

indicators.note: around places the first word outside the second

parts.note: to state is to say
ash is a tree and its wood

explanation.surface: Parading in ceremony around the woodland.
explanation.definitionFit: To sashay is to walk ostentatiously, swinging the hips.

clue.text: Improving verse with song tutor

indicators.note: improving changes something, so these letters are recast

explanation.surface: A teacher improves poetry with music.
explanation.definitionFit: A governess is a woman employed to teach children at home.

clue.text: Purpose of a board game: middle-class leisure, primarily

parts.note: Go is the Japanese strategy game played with stones

indicators.note: middle picks out the centre letter of class
primarily takes the first letter of leisure

explanation.surface: Why the middle classes play board games in their free time.
explanation.definitionFit: A goal is an aim or purpose.

clue.text: Game of love

definitions.meaning: a cricket score of zero, as love is in tennis

explanation.definitionFit: Duck is both a wild bird shot for sport and a score of nothing in cricket.

clue.text: Have a bash with it or in it?

definitions.meaning: a venue to hold a party, a bash, in

explanation.definitionFit: A cudgel for striking and a social venue where a party is held.

clue.text: Board game (backgammon) run with new content

indicators.note: back says the word for gammon is read backwards

parts.note: gammon is cured ham

indicators.note: content means held inside, so new goes within run

parts.note: to jog is to run

explanation.surface: Backgammon is played at speed with fresh pieces.
explanation.walkthrough: The bracketed '(backgammon)' looks like an example of a board game, but the word splits in two: 'back' is the reversal signal and 'gammon' is the meat.
explanation.definitionFit: A Chinese tile game for four, played on a table.

clue.text: Draw level in board game?

parts.note: to board a train is to catch it
game for it means up for it

explanation.surface: A tie in a board game.
explanation.definitionFit: To catch up is to draw level with someone ahead.
